headline: Aave V2 protocol contracts catalogued across Ethereum, Polygon, and Avalanche; core infrastructure contracts identified but chain-specific deployments incomplete

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search and block explorer pages yielded key Ethereum V2 contracts: Lending Pool V2 (0x7d2768dE32b0b80b7a3454c06BdAc94A69DDc7A9), Lending Pool Addresses Provider (0xb53c1a33016b2dc2ff3653530bff1848a515c8c5), Protocol Data Provider (0x057835Ad21a177dbdd3090bB1CAE03EaCF78Fc6d), Governance V2 (0xec568fffba86c094cf06b22134b23074dfe2252c)

Official deployed contracts doc referenced at /docs/resources/legacy-versions/v2 but V2-specific address table not embedded; directs to GitHub repository. Main V2 addresses documentation available via https://docs.aave.com/developers/v/2.0/deployed-contracts/deployed-contracts

V2 audit reports found in security page via aave.com/security showing multiple audits: PeckShield (Sep 2020), Consensys (Sep 2020), Certik (Sep 2020), MixBytes (Sep 2020), SigmaPrime (Jan 2021). Light Deployment audit (PeckShield, Mar 2021)

GitHub repository aave/protocol-v2 confirmed as authoritative source. v2 market deployments confirmed for Ethereum mainnet, Polygon, and Avalanche per documentation; AMM Market also deployed on Ethereum
D5-Polygon: V2 deployment on Polygon confirmed via documentation references but specific contract addresses not yet extracted from per-chain explorer search
D5-Avalanche: V2 deployment on Avalanche confirmed via documentation references but specific contract addresses not yet extracted from per-chain explorer search
Core Ethereum V2 contracts traced to Etherscan explorer pages with verified source code; Governance V2 and Protocol Data Provider addresses verified on-chain

rationale.verdict: Discovery of Aave V2 is in progress. Core Ethereum addresses have been identified and verified on-chain via Etherscan. The protocol documentation structure is confirmed, and GitHub repository points to the authoritative codebase. However, comprehensive enumeration of Polygon and Avalanche deployments requires additional on-chain queries, and token/pool children enumeration has not been conducted. The assessment is incomplete across all chains and does not yet include full address-book enumeration for the control/admin surface.

protocol_metadata.about: Aave V2 is a decentralized non-custodial liquidity protocol enabling users to deposit assets to earn interest and borrow against collateral. The protocol features aTokens (interest-bearing deposits), stable and variable debt tokens, and an upgradeable architecture governed through Aave token-weighted voting. V2 operates across Ethereum, Polygon, and Avalanche with a modular pool system.
